summary: Checked division of zero by zero computes gcd(0, 0) = 0 and then performs integer division by zero, panicking instead of returning None. The fix rejects a zero divisor before this computation. The regression test added by the fix checks that zero.checked_div(&zero) returns None. The proposed reversal removes only that guard; reproduction has not been run.
